messages:
maria: Heads-up: Regulatory pilot (FinTrust) requires a pinned model for audit. Need to decide pin safety checks before we promise one.

kevin: What are the must-haves from infra/ops perspective?

nina: Min requirements I'd push: 1) deterministic snapshot (weights + tokenizer hash), 2) automated output snapshot for a golden prompt set, 3) short TTL option and a pin-waiver legal template.

joel: Ops: we also need a locked fallback route that preserves tokenization (fallback to v2 variant) + rollout guard rails. Must support instant unpin+rollback within 1h.

carla: Compliance: FinTrust needs an immutable artifact for audits and change log. They'll accept a 14-day pinned trial if we provide signed waiver that clarifies potential behavioral deltas after rollback.

maria: Proposal: block public pinning until we ship: a) deterministic snapshot tool, b) N=30 eval pass on FinTrust prompt suite, c) pin-waiver template + legal signoff. Offer dedicated canary with explicit "no-pin" preview while we complete gates.

kevin: ETA estimates: snapshot tooling 4 biz days, N=30 eval run 2 biz days (if GPUs free), rollback automation 5 biz days.

nina: I can run N=30 suite once snapshot tooling exists; will also add randomized seeds to detect non-determinism.

compliance-bot: notice: requirement checklist updated -> immutable-artifact:true, waiver-required:true, retention:90d

joel: Given ETAs, can we offer FinTrust a timed pilot: dedicated canary on isolated infra + weekly evidence bundle (outputs + logs) instead of immediate pin?

carla: FinTrust legal said they'd consider the timed pilot and may sign waiver for 14-day pin if snapshot + audit bundle provided at kickoff. They prefer pin but can accept canary while we finalize artifacts.

maria: Decision path: Do not enable public pin yet. Offer dedicated canary + weekly audit bundles. If deterministic snapshot + N=30 pass and legal signs waiver, allow a time-limited pin (14d TTL) for pilot only. Action items: kevin->snapshot tooling (4d), nina->eval run (2d after snapshot), joel->rollback SLA doc (5d), carla->coordinate legal waiver.

kevin: I'll start snapshot work today and post PR for review.

nina: I'll prep FinTrust prompt suite and standby for runs.

carla: I'll loop in legal and get a waiver draft by end of week.

maria: Thanks all. We'll update FinTrust with the canary offer and ETA. Re-open thread on signoff or failing gate. :white_check_mark:
